title: Tinder Fell To 11 Million Users As Dating Apps Burned Out
hook: Tinder fell to 11 million users as dating apps burned people out.
closing: Swiping promised connection, but burnout is pushing users away.
question: Have you deleted a dating app?

segments.say: Tinder fell to 11 million US users. Millions stopped swiping on the app everyone knows.
Dating app usage fell 16 percent. Tinder's decline was part of a wider retreat.
About 78 percent of dating app users feel drained. Burnout helps explain the exodus.
